query: INSERT INTO social_media_category_settings (streamer_login, category_key, auto_post, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $4) ON CONFLICT (streamer_login, category_key) DO UPDATE SET auto_post = EXCLUDED.auto_post, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
